items.stem: For a Dataproc Spark job, where should durable input and output data normally live?

options.rationale: Correct: Cloud Storage decouples storage from ephemeral clusters and is durable.
HDFS on the cluster is lost when the cluster is deleted.
The boot disk is not durable data storage and disappears with the cluster.
That is unrelated to Spark durable file storage.

items.explanation: Correct: Cloud Storage is the durable data layer for ephemeral clusters.

items.stem: Which TWO practices reduce Dataproc cost? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use ephemeral clusters scoped to a job
options.rationale: Correct: paying only while the job runs cuts idle cost.

options.text: Enable autoscaling to match worker count to load
Keep a large cluster running 24/7 just in case
Store all data on expensive persistent SSD HDFS
options.rationale: That increases cost versus Cloud Storage.

items.explanation: Correct: ephemeral clusters and autoscaling reduce cost.
